title: Meeting of the Braves
overview: In a world where crime has turned fantastical, Braves like Yashiro to take down the magical criminals.

title: A Brave's Magic
overview: Jogamine and Yashiro make a move on the Count of Amber Thorns' base.

title: A Teacher for Braves
overview: Yashiro is adamant about not teaching the girls, but Indo is determined to get stronger with his help.

title: A Brave's Errands
overview: Yashiro finds himself reluctantly paired with Jogamine on an errand for Ishino.

title: A Brave Teacher
overview: Sara comes to Yashiro needing supervision for an assignment from the academy.

title: A Brave's Special Training
overview: Yashiro finds himself in need of quick cash, leading to some fighting lessons with the girls.

title: Death of a Brave
overview: Yashiro, the Grim Reaper, reluctantly takes Aki Jogamine as an apprentice to hunt down Demon Lords.

title: A Brave's Sins
overview: With one of his cohorts dead, Yashiro is out for revenge.

title: A Brave's Legacy
overview: The quest to track down Ishino's killers leads Yashiro to a party being thrown by his long-time nemesis.

title: A Brave's Instruction
overview: Yashiro's confrontation with the Coffin Count of Storms is cut short when the Half Dragon sends assailants.

title: A Brave's Teamwork
overview: As Jogamine drives Yashiro crazy with her refusal to listen to his tactics, he comes to a realization.

title: A Brave's Secret
overview: The confrontation at the party comes to a close, with Jogamine now at the center of another mystery.

title: A Brave's Doubts
overview: Yashiro and the girls head to Hokkaido to try and track down facts about the Half Dragon.

title: A Brave Priest
overview: Yashiro and his apprentices enlist in a mission to execute a raid on a Half Dragon ally.

title: A Brave's Melee
overview: Yashiro and Malta search for info on the Half Dragon inside the Count of the Venusian Veil's fortress.

title: The Darkness of Braves
overview: Yashiro and the girls square off a Half Dragon ally, in hopes of learning more about the enemy.

title: Return of the Braves
overview: Burdened with new information from the mission to Hokkaido, Yashiro returns to find Tokyo a warzone.

title: Braves in Danger
overview: Pursued by Half Dargon forces, Yashiro and the girls try to escape in a stolen van.

title: A Brave's Motivation
overview: Forced onto foot and with Indo missing, Yashiro, Jogamine, and Sara begin the march to Ed's bar.

title: A Brave's Rescue
overview: Yashiro falls into the clutches of the Coffin Count of Storms, but his friends aren't far behind.

title: A Brave's Pride
overview: When the members of Half Dragon shows up to interrupt Yashiro's rescue, it turns into a 4-on-4 battle.

title: A Brave's Ideal
overview: As they pursue the Coffin Count of Storms, Yashiro battles Levi while Jogamine fights Tomoe.

title: A Brave's Truth
overview: The battle against the Coffin Count of Storms continues as Yashiro attempts to uncover her secret.

title: A Brave's Lie
overview: Forced to confront the truth, how will Yashiro react?
